'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Jake from State Farm DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake from State Farm]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Senate "Jake's Senate". Jake from State Farm, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2013 green form. No legal surname

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
